page_title: MCI 4-1 WHU | Manchester City v West Ham 04/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+7' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards right side of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Alphonse Areola pulls off an easy save.
90+2' Manchester City take a short corner kick.

90+2' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Jack Grealish (Manchester City) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The linesman points to the corner flag, Manchester City are going to take it.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
87' We are about to witness a subsitution. Danny Ings (West Ham) for Edson Alvarez.
86' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the right post.
84' Pep Guardiola decides to make a substitution. Erling Haaland will be replaced by Jack Grealish (Manchester City).
83' A dangerous towering header by Tomas Soucek (West Ham) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the left post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
83' The referee awards a corner and Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) goes over to take it.
83' A cross from Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
82' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) darts into the box and immediately fires a first-time effort. He produces a poor shot which goes well over the crossbar.
80' Here comes a substitution. Savinho is given a rest as he is replaced by James McAtee (Manchester City).
80' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
77' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar.
76' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) is penalised for a foul. Michael Salisbury had a clear view and blows his whistle.
74' Stefan Ortega (Manchester City) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
72' Substitution. Luis Guilherme (West Ham) replaces Mohammed Kudus.
71' 4 - 1 Goal! Tomas Soucek tees up Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom left corner. 4:1.
66' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Stefan Ortega.
65' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from mid-range. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance!
64' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Michael Salisbury had an easy-decision to make.
61' Pep Guardiola prepares a substitution. Nathan Ake is replaced by Kyle Walker (Manchester City).
61' It's time for a substitution. Ilkay Gundogan (Manchester City) comes on in place of Mateo Kovacic.
58' 4 - 0 Goal! Kevin De Bruyne provides Phil Foden (Manchester City) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a strike into the middle of the goal. 4:0.
55' 3 - 0 GOAL - 3:0! Savinho found Erling Haaland (Manchester City) inside the box, he spotted goalkeeper Alphonse Areola off his line and chipped the ball into the net. What a cheeky lob!
53' Problems for Julen Lopetegui as Jean-Clair Todibo is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) replaces him.

51' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed under the crossbar, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
46' A cross into the box finds the head of Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) who steers it goalwards, but Stefan Ortega manages to pull off a decent save to thwart him.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+1' Michael Salisbury blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Wonderful movement by Manchester City. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
42' 2 - 0 Goal! Savinho puts the ball on the head of Erling Haaland (Manchester City), who has the easy task to score into an empty net. 2:0.
42' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
38' The corner from Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) is hurriedly cleared.

38' Rico Lewis (Manchester City) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Alphonse Areola makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the roof of the net.
35' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

35' Savinho (Manchester City) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Manchester City.
34' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range went slightly wide of the left post.
34' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
33' Rico Lewis (Manchester City) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Erling Haaland.

32' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Alphonse Areola pulls off a comfortable save.
32' Michael Salisbury couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Tomas Soucek (West Ham) and blew his whistle.
31' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
30' Savinho (Manchester City) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it to the middle of the goal, but Alphonse Areola makes a comfortable save to stop his effort.
29' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) takes a short pass in his stride and attempts to beat the keeper from mid-range, but the shot screeches just wide of the right post.
28' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
28' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
24' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
23' Julen Lopetegui is stunned as referee Michael Salisbury shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
22' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
21' 3:3 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
19' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Michael Salisbury blows his whistle for a foul.
17' Savinho (Manchester City) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
17' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) works the corner short.

16' Savinho (Manchester City) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Manchester City will have a chance to score from a corner.
14' Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
13' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

13' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Manchester City.
13' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City).
10' 1 - 0 OWN GOAL! Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) scores an unlucky own goal after he deflected a shot which went into his own net! 1:0.
9' What a big chance! Tomas Soucek (West Ham) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball well wide of the left post.
7' A sweet pass inside the box gives Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
5' Phil Foden (Manchester City) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alphonse Areola intercepts the ball.
4' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
3' Flag goes up against Erling Haaland (Manchester City) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Manchester City will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Michael Salisbury.
